PMID:23649992 concerns CNB-440. Janso maps KF731828 to DPJ-0016 but explicitly reports D production in DPJ-0019, not DPJ-0016, in the inspected text. Cite the source database for the retained species-level D assertion and the exact deposit for locus provenance; neither establishes DPJ-0016 D production. Do not replace the locus with KF515737 or invent a producer strain. Exact D identity remains unresolved in #976. See #977.

The imported PMID:19129623 studies ATCC35851/pKSL/AB449340, not FXJ1.172/KT591188.1. The inspected 2011 producer study identifies FXJ1.172 product as lasalocid A by mass, UV and MS2 comparison to JCM3373; it does not independently determine absolute stereochemistry or characterize the entire deposited cluster. Route the locus claim to KT591188.1, a putative partial BGC submission, not to the AB449340 experiment. Preserve source-tier grades and original raw references; no taxon, chemistry or locus-coordinate change. See issue #972.

PMID:9770448 (DOI:10.1073/pnas.95.21.12111, Xue et al. 1998) exclusively characterizes the Streptomyces venezuelae ATCC 15439 pik/des cluster (AF079138.1/AF079762.1) and never mentions Streptomyces narbonensis or AF521878.1. Route the retained S. narbonensis species-level producer assertion to the MIBiG 4.0 repository entry and the locus assertion to its deposited GenBank sequence AF521878.1 without upgrading SOURCE_ASSERTION or CLUSTER_UNSTATED grades or altering taxon or structure identity. See issue #1011.

The imported compound-bioactivity reference DOI:10.1016/s0140-6736(00)87452-8 (Chain et al., Lancet 1940;236(6104):226-228) is a 1940 clinical mouse-protection study that predates DNA sequencing and does not characterize Penicillium chrysogenum AS-P-78 or GenBank DQ192518.1 (coordinates 17440..28759). Route the BGC0000404:1 producer and locus claims to Fierro et al. 2006 (PMID:16713314, DOI:10.1016/j.fgb.2006.03.001), which sequenced and characterized the DQ192518.1 penicillin region in P. chrysogenum AS-P-78, without upgrading SOURCE_ASSERTION or CLUSTER_UNSTATED grades or altering taxon or structure identity. See issue #1023.
